positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Nara develops artificial voices by leveraging machine learning and DNNs (Deep Neural Networks). With our team of experts in distributed systems and machine learning we build practical systems to give unique voices to hardware startups, retail brands, IoT devices, and various other use cases.

More information available on the company website
https://www.naravoice.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rentlogic is a standards organization that measures and grades the quality of multi-family residential buildings. We recognize building owners that invest time and energy in to operating great buildings, and help connect them with residents trying to navigate a difficult marketplace.

More information available on the company website
https://www.rentlogic.com

Technology: Python, Django, Java, AWS, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
Recess Labs is a residency program for folks in tech working on new ideas. Hosted at Grand Central Tech in the heart of New York City, we bring fifteen talented technologists together for an extended period to play with projects at the cutting edge of tech, design, and product.

More information available on the company website
www.recesslabs.com

positions.title: Software & Machine Learning (Computer Vision) Engineer
positions.description:
1:1 product recommendations for the cosmetics and beauty industry using machine learning and computer vision. Our proprietary algorithm provides facial mapping and skin analysis to match user's exact skin shade. We can power recommendations for any brand or retailer from a simple selfie.

Want to see how it works in our app? Check Flawless Makeup in the iOS and Android stores:

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/flawless-makeup/id1058669260?mt=8
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mime.flawless.android&hl=en

Technology: Python, Django, Computer Vision, Machine Learning

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
At Mind & Metrics we help small businesses optimize their online marketing efforts by using in-depth analytics. We help them increase conversions, while staying cost effective, freeing up hard earned cash to scale their businesses.

Technology: Wordpress, Shopify, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Photoshop, Illustrator, Sketch

positions.title: Front-End Development Intern
positions.description:
I was responsible for QA of the web platform, improving web page performance, and analyzing new front end frameworks to be adopted on both the consumer-facing platform as well as the internal CMS publishing platform.

- Improved web page load, and response times.
- Developed an internal CSS preprocessor for eliminating unused code
